spans.s: सौगतः [saugatḥ], A Buddhist; a follower of Sugata or Buddha; (the Buddhists are divided into four great schools; माध्यमिक, सौत्रान्तिक, योगाचार & वैभासिक); सौगतजरत्प- रिव्राजिकायास्तु कामन्दक्याः प्रथमां भूमिकां भाव एवाधीते
An atheist, a heretic, an unbeliever. -कम् Unbelief, heresy, atheism, scepticism.
A kind of fragrant grass (कत्तृण). -न्धः A dealer in perfumes.
सौगन्धिक [saugandhika], a. (-का or -की f.) Sweet-scented, fragrant.
कः A dealear in perfumes, perfumer.
A sexually weak man (who is stimulated by the smell of the female organs).
A kind of worm infesting the bowels.
कम् The white water-lily; गृहेषु नानोपवनामलाम्भःसरस्सु सौगन्धिककाननेषु
सौगन्ध्यम् [saugandhyam], Sweetness of odour, fragrance, perfume.
